reason: At zero external force the frozen residual acceptance max(absolute_floor,relative_tolerance*external_force_norm) equals the absolute floor even for moving-boundary-driven motion. Three nominal relative tolerances then provide only one effective accuracy.
reuse: Reuse terminal completed original480Hz/1e-10N baseline, with exact core/physical-input hashes; do not rerun it merely to create a new label.
new_cells: Two fresh outputs at1e-8N and1e-12N only, after baseline stage terminates and reviewed runner extension is published.
unchanged: Exact same material, mesh, full hardware, support law, drag, integrator, force commands, step count, output clocks and250iteration cap. No regularization/solver fallback.
analysis: Full-coordinate trajectory RMSE; tightest two agree within parent max(2micrometres,5percent finest diagonal-minus-zero coordinate RMS). Report all adjacent differences, effective thresholds, residual distributions, geometry/work/energy checks, source revisions and failures. Passing this factorized study does not prove all accuracy/translation/time-step interactions.
failure_preservation: Iteration cap or line-search failure remains a failed cell; no changed tolerance, softened physics, dropped timestep or silent replacement.
publication: Protocol text published before either new floor run; original gate and sealed evidence unchanged.
